facts.text: Evan received a painting from a friend which inspired him to start painting.

evidence.quote: It all started when a friend of mine gave me this painting one day, it inspired me a lot and that's when I started painting.

facts.text: Evan joined a painting class to find like-minded people and improve his skills.

evidence.quote: And I joined the classes to find like-minded people and show them what I can do, you can always improve your skills.

facts.text: Evan is currently painting with the same tools and may consider other classes in the future.

evidence.quote: Just been painting with these for now, but might look into other classes.

facts.text: Evan is taking painting classes where they are learning about watercolors and observing nature.

evidence.quote: In painting classes, we've been learning about watercolors. The instructor stresses observing nature and painting what we see.
